shared_readers.composition: Existing MCP wrappers and default dashboard use epoptia_queries.production_overview/workstation_census.
shared_readers.orders: Existing active_production_progress and _scan_production_pages feed the same OrderCensus: parent workorder.id and native workorder.progress.
shared_readers.stations: Existing fetch_wols and collect_stations: full pagination, archive filtering, separate running/paused/waiting counts.
shared_readers.settings: Existing dotenv/environment provisioning, deferred until reads; no settings contents inspected or reported.

implemented: Independent direct source workers, bounded publication and page budgets, no overlapping retries of timed-out workers.
Last-good/stale retained; cached API GET performs no collection and advances no read counters.
Read IDs and counters recorded at actual shared data-page HTTP boundary; login failure is not a new data read.
Verifier requires three new successful direct read identities/counters and generations after baseline.
Existing widgets render the actual default-provider API; native progress and null station/section values handled without layout changes.
Existing launcher updated for direct default, reviewed fingerprints and 22-test preflight; interactive approval and verify-only preserved.

tests.environment: existing project venv and installed Node
tests.boundaries: Synthetic provisioning and HTTP responses; actual readers/login/mappers/default provider. MCP calls forbidden. Combined Python run also blocked socket connects and real settings loading.
tests.coverage: Three-refresh independence/recovery, blocked source and timeout, multipage scans and page failures, archive filtering, native identity/progress, last-good/stale, cached GET evidence, real API-to-renderer, replay rejection, launcher approval/verify-only.

required_services_to_activate.rationale: Load the direct default provider and updated renderer in the existing dashboard.

live_verification.requirement: After separately approved activation, observe three new successful direct reads per source with the existing verifier.
live_verification.evidence_limit: Application HTTP-boundary instrumentation is not an independent upstream audit.

remaining_unknowns: Unverified parent deadlines and incomplete-coverage overdue totals
restrictions: Pre-existing changes preserved. No credentials/settings contents read, protected configuration edits, Voice Gateway/Ermis System/management edits, network calls, service operations, deployment or push.
